# Murdoch University Library Guides

> Comprehensive library and research support resource covering citation styles, research methodology, data management, and academic writing skills for Murdoch University students and staff.

LibGuides at Murdoch University provides extensive documentation on research skills, referencing standards, and library resources. The site supports students across multiple disciplines with guides on systematic reviews, literature reviews, research data management, generative AI tools, and open educational resources, alongside detailed citation style guides for IEEE, ACS, MLA, Chicago, AGLC, and Vancouver formats.

## Key Topics

- Citation Styles
- Literature Reviews
- Research Methodology
- Research Data Management
- Systematic Reviews
- Open Educational Resources
- Open Access Publishing
- Academic Writing
- Research Metrics
- Generative AI
- FAIR Principles
- Referencing
- Cochrane Standards
- eBook Access
- Research Impact

## Research Methodology & Skills

- [Literature reviews home](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/litreview): Comprehensive guide to literature review methodology and academic research skills
- [Overview - Systematic Reviews](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/systematic): Research methodology guide for conducting systematic reviews using Cochrane standards
- [Home - Measuring Research Quality and Impact](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/measure_research): Guide to research metrics, bibliometrics, and measuring research impact and quality
- [Home - Research ReachOut @ the Library](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/ResearchReachOut): Library training program offering research skills workshops and online sessions

## Citation Styles & Referencing

- [MLA Style - MLA](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/MLA): MLA citation style guide for literature, languages, and humanities
- [IEEE Style - IEEE](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/IEEE): IEEE citation style guide for engineering and technical documentation
- [Vancouver Style - Vancouver](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/Vancouver): Vancouver citation style for medical and scientific journal publications
- [Chicago Notes and Bibliography Style](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/ChicagoNB): Chicago Notes and Bibliography citation style guide for humanities writing
- [ACS Style - ACS](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/ACS): American Chemical Society citation style guide for chemistry and science writing
- [AGLC Style - AGLC](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/AGLC): Australian legal citation style guide for law students and legal writing

## Research Data & Open Access

- [Home - Research Data Management](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/RDM): Guide to research data management, FAIR principles, and data sharing practices
- [Home - Publishing Research](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/publishing): Guide to publishing research, journal selection, and open access publication
- [What are OERs? - Open Educational Resources](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/oer): Guide to Open Educational Resources and affordable learning materials for students

## Technology & AI Tools

- [Generative AI and the Library](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/genAI): Guide to using generative AI tools for academic research and study

## Library Resources & Collections

- [Home - Murdoch University eBook Guide](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/ebooks): Guide to accessing, borrowing, and using eBooks in library collections
- [Home - Subject Level Collection Statements](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/SLCS): Library collection development policies and subject-specific collection statements

## Teaching & Course Support

- [Home - My Unit Readings: Guide for Teaching Staff](https://libguides.murdoch.edu.au/MURGuide): Documentation for teaching staff on managing reading lists and course materials
